seasons.title: Delivery Boys
seasons.arc_summary: The newly formed party takes courier jobs and investigates mounting threats in Hallia — Ugathul imposters, the Pyrelight gang's radar dishes, and Grayson's necromantic Fane hidden deep beneath the city. The arc culminates in the party escaping Grayson's manor with explosive evidence of his psyche-manipulation experiments.

seasons.title: The Black and White
seasons.arc_summary: A devastating total party kill at the Crowded Flea sends three members through death and back, guided by the entity Aut. The party exacts revenge on Hlarf and Tywelwyn Leatherhide, ultimately uncovering that six Thessian gods are using a radar dish network to crack the Firmament and reach Færrin.

seasons.title: The Keystone Hunt
seasons.arc_summary: The party reports their discoveries to the Inquisition, rescues Anaïs from a rival cosmic entity's trap, and learns of the cosmic Narrative. They compete in a deadly pilgrimage scavenger hunt at Ragged Roost, solving puzzles and trading stolen art to secure Keystone 14 from the Heart Rapid Connection.

seasons.title: Cracks in the Firmament
seasons.arc_summary: During months of downtime, Argyle returns in half-alive form, and the party descends into Hallia's sewers to discover a hairline fracture in reality itself — a secret research operation engineering a harmony to shatter the Firmament, funded by Grayson and sanctioned by the Prime Minister. The party bombs the facility, collapsing Teller's Run underground.

seasons.title: The Strider
seasons.arc_summary: The party boards a colossal arachnid Strider city on a voidward pilgrimage, forging a heart-Fane of their own while navigating deadly faction politics, weekly energy tithes, and shifting alliances among nineteen rival organizations. The arc culminates in a deep descent through the Undercroft to awaken an ancient Machine God and purge the Strider of Herald cultists.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In the first session of a new Færrin-set one-shot (now a two-shot), four members of the Velvet Mark — Archie, Salvatore, Branson, and Combo — are tasked by Father Marone to assassinate the Spark, leader of the upstart gang Pyrelight. En route to Teller's Run, they're pulled over by Threshold Authority officers, leading to a violent car chase that ends with the cops' car flipped and destroyed. After ditching their identifiable car at Feathers' shop for a disguise, they sneak into Teller's Run and discover the Spark presiding over a burning-stage spectacle with a cheering crowd.

shows.name: A Hunt of Metal and Vine

seasons.title: The Fall of the Terror and the Descent into the Joker World
seasons.arc_summary: The 8th-grade heroes of Cagley Middle slay the shadow-demon Terror of Cagley in its lair beneath Mt. Cagley, ending Noah's one-shot. The session then pivots to Josh's new Scale one-shot, as four high-ranking operatives are dispatched to a shattered Joker World and descend into a demon-infested chasm.

seasons.title: The Quorum and the Voice of Many
seasons.arc_summary: The Judges' Jocks breach the black-metal Quorum, solve its fiendish puzzles, and fight through Sigzilheight's forces to discover and liberate Voice of Many — a trapped divine heart and grandchild of the Judge — before escaping back to Scale headquarters.

seasons.title: The Husk Murders
seasons.arc_summary: Convox detectives Cedric, Krod, and Andros investigate a wave of huskification murders tied to a mysterious fey stone, tracing leads from the logging town of Wrenford deep into the Verdant Expanse where they battle fey courtiers, and back to Hallia where they discover the Gloaming Codex — a ritual book that pulls them into its pages.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In a one-shot set months before the main campaign, three Undercroft workers — Barlow Crane, Grant FireEye, and Gage the Cunning — investigate sabotage aboard the massive moving Strider city of Iomenei. Tracking an elven suspect named Gerhardt into a long-abandoned forsaken sector, they discover an insectoid infestation centered on a dormant engine heart cathedral and must slay a massive Swarm Hive Mother. Though they halt the infestation, the true saboteur remains at large.

seasons.title: The Everdawn Drift
seasons.arc_summary: Three Sedecium agents investigate an unpowered orbital station half-sunk in the slip, where they free a tortured ship AI, rotate the station back into real space, fight off slip-fiends, and uncover that the Thessian Esoterica recently accessed observatory records of a massive magical spike near the Astra's core.

seasons.title: One Last Job: Stealing from a Dead God
seasons.arc_summary: Pulled from retirement for a single high-stakes raid, the fire team descends through the Slip onto the corpse of the freshly-killed Thessian 'Tithe,' solving a time-acceleration puzzle and fighting through a spider temple to plant a beacon — becoming the first and only team to successfully steal divine essence before the God Eater Harrow consumes it all.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: A D&D 5e one-shot set on the Finnegan Ring caravan route. Three caravan members — Mango the elven ranger, Doug Donahue the gnome rogue, and Egan the orc druid — are transported along with flautist Erin Proudcloak to a fey swampland by a mysterious mist. There, the fey creature Larunan forces them to fight for his amusement in an arena battle full of chaotic magical effects. The party survives and is returned to the caravan.
